_comment: Canonical release notes for Septena. Single source of truth: bundled into the app (Settings ▸ About ▸ What's New + the launch sheet) AND mirrored to the website at build time (septena-site/scripts/sync-changelog.mjs → /changelog). Newest first; the single version:"Unreleased" entry is auto-maintained by the committer-cron (scripts/changelog-stamp.sh): human-readable highlights curated from the commits since the last release, carrying the live build/commit count. It is pinned on top and hidden from the app's What's New launch sheet; the released entries below it are hand-curated and frozen. Cutting a release PROMOTES the Unreleased entry (rename version, set name/summary, curate) — see docs/VERSIONING.md. `section` on a highlight is an optional SectionManifest key (accent color); omit (null) for app-wide changes. NOTE: entries before 0.7.0 are reconstructed from git history (build = commit count at that date), not literal past App Store builds. MARKETING_VERSION in project.yml must match the newest RELEASED entry (the Unreleased entry is exempt).

releases.name: In development
releases.summary: Changes since 0.7.0, refreshed automatically as work lands.

highlights.title: A big overhaul of Tasks
highlights.detail: Inline editing and quick-add, drag onto Today to re-home, project section headings, multi-select bulk actions, calendar events woven into Today and Upcoming, and a redesigned date picker.

highlights.title: Recently Deleted for tasks
highlights.detail: Deleted tasks now rest in a Recently Deleted view with one-tap restore and a 30-day auto-purge, plus a longer completion undo window.

highlights.title: Photo-first meal capture
highlights.detail: Snap a meal and have it analyzed on-device to prefill the details, with optional ingredient breakdowns and one-tap re-logging scaled by amount.

highlights.title: Smarter training sessions
highlights.detail: Reps-before-load progression hints on strength sets, editable start and end times, a redesigned progress chart, and an auto-advance rest flow with a watch Live Activity.

highlights.title: Weekly training review
highlights.detail: Effort-weighted muscle volume adds up into a post-session weekly review so you can see what you've been working.

highlights.title: Suggested goals for more of your life
highlights.detail: Goal suggestions now cover chores, gut, habits, medications, mood, supplements, and symptoms, and you can pin any goal to the dashboard.

highlights.title: Watch feed refresh
highlights.detail: A time-of-day sky behind the Next feed, tappable intake tiles for quick logging, an action drawer for Next rows, and a fasting complication that morphs overnight.

highlights.title: Clearer privacy controls and a What's New screen
highlights.detail: Choose from graded analytics levels and see exactly what's sent, plus a new What's New changelog in Settings. You can also copy your grocery list to the clipboard.

releases.name: AI hub & community
releases.summary: A home for everything AI, a real community board, and a calmer everyday surface.

highlights.title: Run the MCP server from iPhone
highlights.detail: Connect Claude to your Septena data from iOS too, with connected apps folded into one AI hub.

highlights.title: Settings, reorganized into seven hubs
highlights.detail: Everything is grouped by intent now, with a unified Claude & AI hub.

highlights.title: A real community board
highlights.detail: Comment threads, a public feature board you can vote on, testimonials, and moderation.

highlights.title: Quieter capture
highlights.detail: Every quick-add menu has a full-editor escape hatch, and section drawers open straight into the log.

releases.name: Identity & depth
releases.summary: The app's voice comes through, training gets deeper, and units finally bend to you.

highlights.title: A log is a vote
highlights.detail: The idea that every entry is a small act of self-investment now runs through onboarding and the little celebrations when you log.

highlights.title: Choose metric or imperial
highlights.detail: One global switch for weight, distance, and volume. Your data stays metric underneath; only what you see and type changes.

highlights.title: Effort on every strength set
highlights.detail: Log difficulty as RIR or a plain scale, whichever you think in.

highlights.title: Skip a supplement for today
highlights.detail: Mark a supplement skipped without breaking your streak, just like habits.

highlights.title: Watch rings match your colors
highlights.detail: The macro and training rings on the watch pick up each metric's color from Settings.

releases.name: Front door
releases.summary: The home screen becomes a living dial of your day under a real sky.

highlights.title: Your day as a dial
highlights.detail: A day-dial hero spins so 'now' sits at the top, with the date upright and the sun and moon where they belong.

highlights.title: The real sky, overhead
highlights.detail: The top of the dashboard washes with the actual color of the sky right now, from the sun's true elevation.

highlights.title: Rhythm wheel, colored by kind
highlights.detail: The day wheel plots what you took, each kind in its own color.

highlights.title: One way to start a section
highlights.detail: Section onboarding is unified into a single, consistent first-run flow.

releases.name: Localized & named
releases.summary: Septena speaks Portuguese, settles its names, and sharpens its icons.

highlights.title: Brazilian Portuguese
highlights.detail: The interface, notifications, and Siri phrases are translated to pt-BR.

highlights.title: Concrete icons everywhere
highlights.detail: Generic 'sparkle' glyphs are gone — every surface uses a real, specific symbol.

highlights.title: Move suggestions on demand
highlights.detail: Ask for tidy-up suggestions outside the inbox, when you want them.

highlights.title: Full-color discs on the watch
highlights.detail: The watch corner complication wears Septena's discs mark.

releases.name: Polish
releases.summary: Editing gets richer, the watch gets steadier, and the Claude link tells you when it needs you.

highlights.title: Full task quick-edit
highlights.detail: Edit every field of a task — deadline, area, project, notes — from one sheet.

highlights.title: A gentle reconnect cue for Claude
highlights.detail: When the Claude connection goes stale, a quiet, non-modal nudge appears instead of a hard wall.

highlights.title: Steadier watch refresh
highlights.detail: The watch reads a single Next snapshot instead of replaying the whole sync zone.

releases.name: Life OS
releases.summary: Septena grows from a task app into one place for every corner of your life.

highlights.title: Sections become the shape of the app
highlights.detail: Each life domain is a section you can turn on or hide without ever losing data.

highlights.title: Nutrition with photos and full macros
highlights.detail: Log meals with photos and complete macro and micronutrient detail.

highlights.title: Water, gut, mood, training, groceries
highlights.detail: New sections arrive — with hydration layered over nutrition — each with a first-run intro.

highlights.title: Insights from your own data
highlights.detail: An on-device correlation engine surfaces patterns across what you track.

releases.name: Foundation
releases.summary: The first cut — a fast, focused task manager to build everything else on.

highlights.title: A proper task manager
highlights.detail: Sidebar with Inbox, Today, and Upcoming, organized into areas and projects.

highlights.title: Fast capture
highlights.detail: Inline entry and multi-select for getting things down without friction.
